# The net force

<!-- STEP id="unbalanced" -->
If one team pulls harder, the forces are unbalanced, and a net force acts. The rope moves towards the larger force.

The net force is the difference of the two forces, in the direction of the larger one.

<!-- STEP id="same" -->
Two people push a stalled car in the same direction. Now the net force is the sum of the two forces.

**The motion of an object depends only on the net force.**
